description: This file defines a class that performs a post-processing transformation to ensure that HTML <bdo> tags have the 'dir' attribute set, assigning a default value if missing.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_BdoDir
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform to add a 'dir' attribute to <bdo> tags if missing, using default configuration.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the attribute array, adding a 'dir' attribute with the default text direction if it is not already set.
